Package index

about topicovertime

topicovertime fits the Topics over Time model of Wang and McCallum (2006) in R.

topicovertime topicovertime-package
topicovertime: Topics over Time: A Continuous-Time Topic Model

model fitting

tot()
Fit a Topics over Time model

post-estimation

terms(<tot>)
Most probable words per topic
topic_time()
Topic proportions over time
predict(<tot>)
Predict topics or timestamps for new documents
plot(<tot>)
Plot topic trends or topic time densities

simulation

simulate_tot()
Simulate documents from a Topics over Time model
